highlights: central west end living with amenities close by
description:
Situated in an attractive West End development just moments away from Duke Street and Grange Road amenities is this spacious top floor apartment. Offering central living with modern interior, en-suite and allocated parking, this home is currently tenanted and would ideally suit an investor landlord. The accommodation comprises: communal entrance hallway, separate inner vestibule leading to the main front door of the apartment, private entrance hallway, spacious living room with wall mounted fire and French doors with Juliette style balcony and separate kitchen which is again a good sized room with space for dining table and is fitted with white units, dark worktops, mosaic style tiles, integrated oven/hob with extractor above, integrated washing machine, space for appliances and integrated wine/bottle rack. The entrance hallway also provides access to two bedrooms, the main of which has en-suite shower room, and main bathroom/wc which is fitted with a white suite. Externally the apartment stands in attractive communal grounds which are laid to lawn with shrubbery, there is also allocated and visitor parking which is accessed via car from Trinity Road and additional gated pedestrian access accessed via Abbey Road.

COMMUNAL ENTRANCE HALLWAY Intercom access and access to all floors and apartments.

SEPARATE INNER VESTIBULE With door from communal entrance hallway and main door to the apartment.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY With two storage cupboards.

LIVING ROOM 13' 5" x 10' 11" (4.09m x 3.34m) Spacious room with wall mounted fire and French doors with Juliette style balcony.

KITCHEN 10' 4" x 9' 8" (3.16m x 2.97m) Fitted with white units, dark worktop, mosaic style tiles, integrated oven/hob with extractor above, integrated washing machine, space for appliances, pan shelf, window to the side, vinyl floor and space for dining table and chairs.

BEDROOM ONE 15' 2" x 11' 5" (4.63m x 3.50m) Window to the side.

EN-SUITE With window to the side and fitted with shower cubicle which is tiled, sink in vanity unit and toilet.

BEDROOM TWO 12' 6" x 8' 0" (3.82m x 2.45m) Window to the side.

BATHROOM/WC With window to the front, partially tiled and fitted with a white suite comprising: bath, sink in vanity unit and toilet.

EXTERNALLY the apartment stands in attractive communal grounds which are laid to lawn with shrubbery, there is also allocated and visitor parking which is accessed via car from Trinity Road and additional gated pedestrian access accessed via Abbey Road.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band D Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
